notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
We are happy to release patch 1.2!

What's new: 

- MacOS support!

- Added new Infinity level! - Test your tactical skills in the survival level. You will get gold for each new record. This level is available after zone 2. 
- Added new effect for "fast turrets reload" bonus

- Fixed different effects 
- Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31178296/0f3ecfd359c07f4583e2687f1baae24fa6c0bba6.gif[/img]
We are ready to release patch 1.1!!

What's new:

- Added Restart level feature.
- Added Pop-up about new unit in game. It shows vulnerabilities of the enemy.
- Added Button “Repeat dialogue” in the quest info
- Added Encyclopedia in the game. (Inside the Mansion window)
- Added Flying Carrier and Zeppelins on the map

- Fixed problem with Chain lightning effect
- Fixed problem with Fire range upgrades 
- Fixed problems with 4k displays and ultra wide displays
- Fixed problem with quests – “Capture 3 random missions”

- UI Effects: Rotating gears, Fill a steam bar effect, Effect for the Tower's clock

notes.title: ROADMAP
notes.content:
Thank you all, who share with us ideas, thoughts and bugs. Here is our roadmap for now! The main discussion is here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/622460/discussions/0/3288067088118717556/

[b]Version 1.1:[/b]
- [Done] Fix problem with quests – “Capture 3 random missions”
- Restart level feature. If you lose you can instantly repair your tower and restart the level.
- Fix problems with 4k displays and ultra wide displays
- Pop-up about new unit in game. It will show vulnerabilities of the enemy.
- Button “Repeat dialogue” in the quest info.
- Encyclopedia in the game. (Inside the Mansion window)
- Encyclopedia in the site. (More detailed)
- Flying Carrier and Zeppelins on the map.
- Add some minor effects.
- Hot fixes

[b]Version 1.2:[/b]
- More Challenge levels in the end of the game
- [consideration] New feature - Special Challenge level
- “Arriving” the Carrier in the town
- Translation to more languages
